payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear understanding of the problem of session segmentation in conversation systems, highlighting its importance and the proposed solutions.

claims.text: The problem of session segmentation involves retaining relevant context utterances while eliminating irrelevant ones in conversation systems.
Traditional document segmentation methods are not suitable for conversation session segmentation due to the unique characteristics of dialogue.
The proposed embedding-enhanced TextTiling approach improves session segmentation by using modern embedding techniques to capture semantics in noisy conversation data.
